Animate.Name: Animate Time Changes
Animate.Hint: Run the clock, turn the wheel and move the moons through a change of time, rather than jumping straight to the new time.

Theme.Name: Calendar Style
Theme.Hint: How the calendar looks, for you: gold on a night sky, bronze and ink on parchment, or steel on Underdark stone.

SeasonTrim.Name: Dress the Sky for the Season
SeasonTrim.Hint: Trim the rim of the sky about the day wheel, for everyone: frost and icicles for winter, a flowering vine for spring, sunflowers for summer, and fallen leaves for autumn. Follow the seasons as the year turns, with festivals dressed for the day, or keep to one season all year.

BarTrim.Name: Dress the Bar for Your Adventure
BarTrim.Hint: Trim the calendar's bar for the adventure you're running, for everyone.
BarTrim.Obelisk: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk

SceneDarkness.Name: Darken Scenes at Night
SceneDarkness.Hint: Keep the active scene's darkness in step with the sky: light by day, fading through the late afternoon and twilight as the sun sinks, dark at night, and a little lighter under a bright moon. Scenes with their darkness locked are left alone.

SeasonalDaylight.Name: Long Summer Days
SeasonalDaylight.Hint: Move sunrise and sunset with the seasons: sixteen hours of daylight at midsummer and eight at midwinter. D&D 5e's dawn and dusk recovery, the day wheel and the scene's darkness all follow.

AnnounceDays.Name: Announce Each Dawn
AnnounceDays.Hint: Post each new day to the chat as the sun rises on it, with the date, the start of a season, and any festival. A jump over several days posts only the last.

Calendars.Name: Additional Calendars
Calendars.Label: Choose Calendars
Calendars.Hint: Add calendars for settings D&D 5e doesn't cover, such as Exandria and Krynn, to its Configure Calendar.

Chat.Speaker: The Calendar
Chat.GMOnly: Only the GM can move the time.
Chat.Usage: Try {command} 8 hours, {command} 1 day 6 hours, or {command} dawn, noon, dusk or midnight.

Enable.Title: Turn On the Calendar?
Enable.Content: Simple D&D Calendar shows D&D 5e's calendar, which is turned off in this world. Turn it on now? You can change this later under Game Settings → Configure Calendar.
Enable.Recovery: With the calendar on, D&D 5e recovers daily, dawn and dusk item uses as time passes rather than on a long rest, unless its Daily Recovery Mode says otherwise.

Calendars.Title: Additional Calendars
Calendars.Hint: Tick the calendars to add to D&D 5e's. Once the world reloads, they are choices in D&D 5e's Configure Calendar, with their moons, seasons and holidays on the calendar.
Calendars.InUse: The world's calendar, so it can't be removed.

Exandria.Name: Exandrian Calendar (Exandria)
Exandria.Hint: Tal'Dorei and Wildemount: eleven months over 328 days, from 836 PD, with Catha and Ruidus.

Krynn.Name: Solamnic Calendar (Krynn)
Krynn.Hint: Dragonlance: twelve months of 28 days, from 351 AC, with Solinari, Lunitari and Nuitari.
